title: Teaching Alec Bigard and Emile's vote for Foster
summary: Foster says he tried to teach Alec Bigard the technique without success, and that Bigard's uncle Emile, a violinist, first voted him over Red Happy.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Well, none of the drummers, those drummers never show you that. I tried to learn Alec Begaard that, but he never could learn it. I never saw anybody do that. Well, you know, in fact, to tell you the truth, Alec Begaard, our uncle was a great violin player too.
Emil. Well, he was the first one that voted me over happy. Oh really? Yeah, and he was the one that made me know how good I was. We're just about out of tape here.
